note: ESTIMATE — conservative per-roll = ticks×tick$×base_contracts; real cost varies by actual position size/roll dates. FACTS for morning triage, not a verdict.
headline: RESOLUTION (a): the estimate over-predicts by orders of magnitude. Roll cost is charged PER-TRADE only when entry_idx is a rollover day (backtester.py ~7242 is_rollover_day gate), NOT accumulated across every roll on a held position. Rollover days ~4/yr (MES/MNQ), ~12/yr (MCL); the corpus is EOD-flat day-trading (15:55 time-stop) so only the few trades entering on a rollover day pay roll. Defect-4 asymmetry CONFIRMED REAL (net_pnl subtracts _roll_cost_usd_cls line ~7284; equity loop omits it -> divergence = sum of rollover-day-entry rolls) but SMALL: <=$1 on ~6y Gate-3 (completes, as observed), >$1 only on long-history (ae7a2560 11y = $52.67, which IS roll cost accumulated, so reconciliation (c) also false). REAL BLAST RADIUS: long-history Mode A/B (~11y) runs only -> Gate-3/pass-3 (trade-count, ~6y) UNAFFECTED; corpus re-baseline equity AFFECTED. Fix = add _roll_cost_usd_cls to the class equity loop (mirror net_pnl), pre-re-baseline tier with Defects 7/8/9.
